editorial:
Imagine two of the meanest gangs in Los Angeles meeting up for a huge weapons deal, only to realize they are not alone in the warehouse. Instead of a payday, you get a nightmare full of hungry zombies. You get to see these tough guys, who usually hate each other, forced to team up with the police just to stay alive. The vibe is gritty and loud, mixing street culture with a classic monster movie feel. It is not trying to be a deep drama; it just wants to throw you into a bloody fight for survival where the enemies are coming from both sides.

What really works here is the fast action and the way the movie doesn't take itself too seriously. While some of the acting is a bit stiff, the gore and the fight scenes make up for it. It is a great pick if you want something mindless and exciting for a movie night.
endingExplained: As the chaos peaks, the survivors realize they cannot just fight their way out. The movie wraps up with a desperate push to escape the warehouse before they are completely overrun. After a lot of shooting and fighting, a few characters manage to make it out alive, but the horror does not just stop. The ending suggests that the zombie plague is spreading beyond the warehouse, leaving you with the feeling that the city is doomed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves B-movie horror and gang wars.
